rationale: The agent verified the user via email with tool confirmation, accessed only the authenticated user’s orders, and provided recent order details using read-only tools. The agent asked for explicit confirmation before performing any write action, clearly stating the item to return and the refund method. After receiving a clear “yes,” the agent submitted the return using the correct item ID and the requested PayPal method. The tool response confirmed the status changed to return requested, and the agent communicated accurate final information (refund to PayPal upon processing and email with return instructions). No unsupported claims, no actions on the wrong account, and no writes without confirmation. All actions align with policy.
